description: Let your imagination flow! Cubes Crafter is a 3D game creator and world editor, for PC and tablets. Use the mouse or the touchscreen to edit the 3D world. Select a material with the left scrolling bar and select an action with the right scrolling bar: create a single cube, create a cuboid or a sphere of cubes, create floating islands of cubes, ... Whenever you want, press the bottom button to switch to play mode and move the character with the keyboard, the mouse, the touchscreen, or a Xbox360 joystick! You can save or load your creation with the floppy disk button on the right scrolling bar.
